op.title: Anyone heard of Project Five Suns?
op.body: I've got people telling me that something big is going down in the four corners region. I already tried a FOIA but they wouldn't give me shit. The only document that's not redacted out the ass is just some religious shit about native american gods and alistair crowley. Anyone else know WTF this is?

replies.body: Alester Crowley was a known leftist/homosexual British spy. I find it very hard to believe that our government has any interest in him beyond stockpiling his books to be used as toilet paper in an emergency.

Just FOIA it yourself bro. I already said it's redacted shit. Here's an excerpt though

I would like to clarify that there is nothing wrong with being a homosexual, I was merely stating the fact that Alester Crowley was one.
